title: 环形链表
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: One finished static Chinese algorithm proof infographic for the dark Bamboo Copter desktop application. This replaces a concrete-example-only illustration. The main content must be a rigorous general proof of Floyd cycle detection, LeetCode 141, NOT the proof of finding a cycle entrance.
Generate a polished landscape 3:2 educational image, around 1536x1024 composition. Deep charcoal #171b20, warm white readable crisp simplified Chinese sans-serif typography, restrained mint for slow and amber for fast. Flat precise diagrams, thin arrowheads, neat whitespace. No mascot, glossy 3D, fake app window, play buttons, watermark, source code block or excessive tiny cards. The general proof is the visual focus, the numerical example only a small check strip.

Exact content and logical layout:
Top title: "25  环形链表"
Subtitle: "为什么任意有环链表, 快慢指针都必然相遇?"
Small method line: "slow 每轮走 1 步, fast 每轮走 2 步. 先移动, 再比较节点身份."

Upper-left diagram: a simple head H leads via a directed tail into cycle entrance E. Inside one clean directed oval cycle show distinct node markers, slow mint and fast amber on two different cycle nodes. Every graph edge is along next with consistent clockwise arrows. Label tail "环外 a 步", loop "环长 L ≥ 1". This is a schematic, not to scale; no specific example node values in this graph. Two concise lines below: "slow 入环时, fast 也已经在环内." "定义 d 为 fast 相对 slow 的环内偏移, 取值 0...L−1."

Upper-right / center large proof panel, legible formula and clear numbered reasoning:
"一般证明"
"d = (fast 的偏移 − slow 的偏移) mod L"
"每轮相对多走 1 步:"
"d' = (d + 1) mod L"
Draw a short directed progression strip "d  →  (d+1) mod L  →  ...  →  0" and label below "模 L 的偏移逐个遍历, 一定到达 0."
Then a strong conclusion: "至多再走 L 轮必相遇, 返回 true."
Small supporting note: "如果 slow 入环当轮已相遇, 直接返回."
Important: do not say fast closes a gap of d or changes by -1; the chosen definition increases by +1 modulo L.

Lower middle two compact columns:
Column left heading "无环为什么终止?"
Text: "fast 或 fast.next 为 null 时返回 false."
Diagram: four small nodes next→next→next→null, fast reaches the end. No return edge.
Column right heading "两个容易混淆的细节"
Text: "a = 0 时, 初始重合不算检测; 移动后第 L 轮重遇."
Text: "判断的是同一节点, 不是值相等."
Text: "首次相遇点不一定是入环点; 本题只返回 true / false."

Bottom numerical check strip, clearly labeled "示例只用于核对, 不是一般证明"
"head = [3,2,0,−4], 尾节点 next → 索引 1"
Small table, columns "移动轮数 | slow 索引 | fast 索引"
Rows "0 | 0 | 0 (初始化)", "1 | 1 | 2", "2 | 2 | 1", "3 | 3 | 3 (相遇)"
Conclusion "相遇在索引 3, 入环点是索引 1."
No extra graph here, no duplicated broken return arrows.

Footer: "时间 O(N)    辅助空间 O(1)"
"N 为不同节点数. 有环时 N = a + L; 只维护两个指针, 不修改链表."

All mathematics and edge direction must be exact. Keep formulas readable and all text inside margins. Make general reasoning prominent; small table stays secondary. Avoid adding entry-reset pointers, a=b+c, a=c, n-circuit formulas or any LeetCode 142 logic.
edits: Edit target: the attached final LeetCode 141 Chinese educational infographic. Make exactly one localized text correction: in the lower middle card, replace its heading "两个容易混淆的细节" with "容易混淆的细节". Keep every other pixel as close as possible: all mathematical formulas, numbered items 1, 2, 3, diagram arrows, node positions, example table, title, font style, colors and 1536x1024 landscape layout remain unchanged. Do not rewrite, redesign, add or remove any other content. The correction removes an incorrect item count.

review.example: 示例仅核对, head=[3,2,0,-4], pos=1, slow/fast 索引依次 (0,0)(1,2)(2,1)(3,3). 相遇索引 3 不等于入口索引 1.
review.steps: 一般证明独立于示例. slow 入环时 fast 已在环内; d=(fast偏移-slow偏移) mod L, 每轮 d'=(d+1) mod L. 有限的 L 个余数逐一遍历, 最多再走 L 轮相遇. 入环当轮若已相遇则直接返回. a=0 时排除初始重合, 先移动再比较, 第 L 轮重遇. 节点比较用身份, 非值.
review.complexity: 无环 fast 或 fast.next 为 null 则 false. 有环 N=a+L, 入环前 O(a), 环内最多 O(L), 总时间 O(N), 辅助空间 O(1). 未混用 142 入口公式.
review.text: 1536x1024 原图实际视觉核查: 一般证明为主, 顺时针 next 箭头成闭环且 H 连 E; 模 L 公式、移后比较、无环 null 条件和数值核对表都正确, 没有裁切或水印. 局部编辑仅把栏目标题改为'容易混淆的细节', 逐项确认公式、箭头、例表和3条细节保持正确. 图与元数据统一用 N 表示不同节点总数.
